import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
#check_failure MvPolynomial.taylor_map
namespace MvPolynomial.TaylorMapRaw
variable {σ τ R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
def shift (α : σ → R) : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
  aeval fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)
theorem substitution (f : R →+* S) (g : σ → MvPolynomial τ R)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    map f (aeval g P) = aeval (map f ∘ g) (map f P) :=
  map_eval₂ f g P
theorem oldForm (f : R →+* S) (α : σ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    shift (fun j ↦ f (α j)) (map f P) = map f (shift α P) := by
  simpa only [shift, Function.comp_apply, map_add, map_X, map_C] using
    (map_eval₂ f (fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)) P).symm
#print axioms substitution
#print axioms oldForm
#print oldForm
end MvPolynomial.TaylorMapRaw
